limitation.headline: Conditional recipient-household welfare, not total social welfare
limitation.recipientLedgerCoverage: Disjoint gain and burden-only mental-health service exposure cohorts; wider recipient portfolio unknown
limitation.counterpartyWelfare: Unknown signed effect on taxpayers, creditors, employers, displaced households/workers and service partners; absent numerical pathway is a conditional omission, not an observed zero
limitation.fiscalAccounting: Donor-plus-fiscal outlay stress is a different denominator; transfer outlay is not taxpayer welfare loss or real-resource consumption
limitation.delayPopulation: Forecast service-onset cohort conditional on being alive and eligible then; not the same fixed present-day cohort followed through the lag. Lag mortality/selection and additional recruitment requirements are unknown. Positive collection follows delay; pre-service application/process burdens are at time0.
